services.desc: Cancellation Policy We understand that unanticipated events happen occasionally in everyone’s life. In our desire to be effective and fair to all clients, the following policies are honored: 24 hour advance notice is required when cancelling an appointment. This allows the opportunity for someone else to schedule an appointment. If you are unable to give us 24 hours advance notice you will be charged the 50 % amount of your appointment. Cancellations within 4 hours will be charged 100%No-shows Anyone who either forgets or consciously chooses to forgo their appointment for whatever reason will be considered a “no-show.” They will be charged for their “missed” appointment. services.name: Couples Massage
services.desc: Experience massage side-by-side with your loved one (or bestie) in our beautiful couples’ suite. Choose from Swedish, Deep Tissue, Ashiatsu or Hot Stone massage, based on availability of therapist. If you’re looking to make your experience a bit more special, you’ll enjoy the extravagance of our Romance Package- perfect for Honeymoons, Anniversaries, Birthdays, or any other special occasion! This session begins with complimentary champagne (or sparkly water), includes two side-by-side 60 or 90 minute massages (choose from swedish, coastal custom, deep tissue or ashiatsu), one Blissful Upgrade for each of you, and ends with a session in our private infrared sauna.
